text: Chaplain Ogrul is an Orsimer Healer, and acolyte of the Imperial Cult. He resides at Fort Darius, the Imperial Legion facility in Gnisis, where he serves as the Healer for the Deathshead Legion garrison. His services are available to faction members and the public alike.

Chaurus Reapers are hostile creatures that can be found in underground caverns throughout . They also appear in the swamps near Solitude and Morthal. They are much larger and stronger than the normal Chaurus, and are considered insects as described by literature found in Skyrim. A dead Chaurus will also provide Chaurus Chitin and occasionally Chaurus Eggs.
Chark is a Redguard healer and worshiper of Molag Bal who may be found within the Daedric Ruin of Esutanamus.

An Anti-Air Missile or Surface-to-Air Missile (SAM) is a guided weapon designed to primarily engage enemy aircraft. Many kinds of anti-air missiles can only be used against aircraft, requiring an active weapon lock in order to launch the missile.

Coldwind is a unique ghostly Snow Bear that was used by King Torug during the First Era. It can be found only during the quest "A Cold Wind From the Mountain," which can be started after all the quests are completed and all the artifacts in Wrothgar are found.

A Cockatrice is a creature with with the face and legs of a chicken, the body of a serpent, the wings of a bat, and the tail of a dragon. They hatch from eggs, and their form and powers change shape depending on what realm they are born in. In 3E 429, Nulfaga performed a floor dance involving lit and unlit candles to initiate extraplanar travel to the Mantellan Crux, in a transition seen as melting walls and vaporizing floor, where she entered a world of pure chaos, engorged, and in a whirl gravity rotated on an axis. She went to the Crux to fight a Cockatrice for its egg, saying "The egg is yours to take. It will spring forth another cockatrice, but it will be very different in this world. Far less strange, far more dangerous. Remember, people reflect their shadows, not the other way around. The foul tide must rise and drown you before it subsides."
Corruption of Air is a wraith located at the Wyrd Tree, Glenumbra, in .

The Boeing B-52 Stratofortress is a long-range, subsonic, jet-powered strategic bomber. The B-52 was designed and built by Boeing, who have continued to provide support and upgrades. It has been operated by the United States Air Force (USAF) since the 1950s. The bomber carries up to 70,000 pounds (32,000 kg) of weapons, the most of any active bomber.
Corruption of Earth is a wraith located at the Wyrd Tree, Glenumbra, in .
Curalmil is a draugr boss in ; at higher levels, Curalmil is a dragon priest.

Daedra Conjurer is a random NPC who can be seen chanting and performing a ritual. They summon a Daedra but are immobilised by it and will only be freed when the Vestige kills it. They will then teleport away.

The Messerschmitt BF 110 was a German multi-purpose combat aircraft used during World War II. Primarily used as a heavy fighter, the BF 110 was designed in the 1930s and entered service in 1937. Approximately 6,170 were built.
Danica Pure-Spring is a Nord priestess and healer of Kynareth found at the Temple of Kynareth in Whiterun.

Darien Gautier is a Breton captain of the Camlorn Guard, residing in Camlorn, Glenumbra, in . He is the son of General Gautier, and is first met in the Camlorn Chapel. It is later implied that he is romantically interested in Gloria Fausta, and possesses a form of precognition of viewing future events.

The Deepscorn Prisoner is a captive in Deepscorn Hollow. The Prisoner is primarily designed as a safe and easy way for a Vampiric character to feed. Since he is essentially what one paid for, the "cattle" is in an eternal slumber within the cell. He cannot wake up, nor can he be killed. This affords the opportunity to utilize him in other ways.

The Angled Grip is a weapon attachment that is similar to the Foregrip yet allows the operator to lay the palm of their hand onto the grip while pushing the thumb down on the top of the gun. The AFG-2 is a type of angled weapon grip that uses a slanted triangle to rest the user's hand, and allow for better grip of the firearm.
Deep-Thoughts is a magus of the Mages Guild found in the hall of the Hollow City.

Diagna or Orichalc God of the Sideways Blade was said to be the avatar of HoonDing, coming from Yokuda during an event known as the Twenty Seven Snake Folk Slaughter. He brought orichalc weapons to the Yokudans which aided them in defeating the Lefthanded Elves. In Tamriel, he had a number of followers who called themselves the Order of Diagna. This order was responsible for defeating the Orcs during the Siege of Orsinium. Eventually he became unrecognized, known only as a local power spirit of the Dragontail Mountains.

Delphine Jend is a Breton member of the Bravil Mages Guild. She is a spell merchant and Journeyman Destruction Trainer. She prides on being the creator of the "Enemies Explode" fireball spell. She seems to loathe Kynareth and her woodland creatures just like the Master level Destruction trainer Bralsa Andaren.

Armored Piercing Shells are Tank munitions designed to penetrate armor of other heavy vehicles. Armor Piercing shells appears as vehicle specializations in Battlefield 3, Battlefield 4, and Battlefield V. __TOC__
Derik Hallin is a powerful Redguard spirit in found in HoonDing's Watch.

Dragon Priests (Dragon Language: Dovah-Sonaak, "Dragon-Priest(s)") are powerful undead enemies found in . Thousands of years ago, these priests ruled over Skyrim at the behest of their Dragon overlords. In their service, many of these dragon priests were granted extraordinary powers and knowledge in arcana, and some of them managed to reach lichdom to evade their own demise. They are typically buried in one of the many ancient tombs and temples dotted all across Skyrim, awaiting the return of Alduin the "World-Eater." There are eight high ranking priests, each wearing a unique dragon priest mask that bears a powerful enchantment said to be bestowed them directly from their dragon benefactors. These priests can be encountered at any level, and are typically found within Nordic tombs and ruins that house Word Walls. Often they are accompanied by an array of undead underlings, such as draugr and skeletons.

The Dragonguard Fire Mage is a generic character residing in the Tomb of the Dragonguard in Sancre Tor. This enemy is raised by Mannimarco to spit upon Sai Sahan's pride during the quest "Shadow of Sancre Tor."

The Alternate Weapon Package is a Specialization in Battlefield: Bad Company 2 for various vehicles: *The M1A2 Abrams and T-90 Main Battle Tanks gain a Coaxial Machine Gun as a secondary weapon for the driver. *The M3A3 Bradley and BMD-3 Infantry Fighting Vehicles gain a wire-guided missile as an alternate weapon for the driver. *The AH-64 Apache and Mi-28 Havoc Attack Helicopters gain a Tracer Dart-guided missile. The gunner can fire a Tracer Dart, and the pilot's missile will home onto any target designated with a Tracer Dart. *The UAV-1 gains a machine gun in addition to its missile strike. This is an active specialization, meaning it can only be used by the driver (except in the case of attack helicopters, as previously described) of the vehicle, and it must be activated by user input to function. It does not function on armored cars, naval vessels, or Quad Bikes as none of them have driver-mounted weapons. BFBC2 M1A2 ATACAMA.jpg|An M1A2 with an Alternate Weapon Package, using a co-axial machine gun.

Draugr are undead Nordic warriors of Skyrim. It is believed that draugr once served the Dragon Priests; some even know several Words of Power. It is also believed that they are cursed with undeath for treachery. Draugr are among the most common foes in Skyrim's many crypts and catacombs. They retain the ability to wield weapons such as swords, axes, and bows, and higher-ranked draugr can even use Dragon Shouts, most notably Unrelenting Force. Some draugr can also use frost magic, such as Conjure Frost Atronach. Most draugr use ancient Nordic weapons, although the high-ranking variants can use ebony weapons. Some draugr only appear as corpses, usually containing a few pieces of gold. Draugr loot includes a chance of bone meal, jewelry, gems, soul gems, ingots, or potions. Their armor can be crafted at the Skyforge in Whiterun after completing The Companions quest "Glory of the Dead," or found in these locations, but it can never be looted directly from them, as the armor is a part of their model.

The Draugr Death Overlord is a variant of draugr found in . It is the strongest draugr variant, is one of the most powerful types of undead, and typically serves as the final foe in a dungeon of draugr residents.

Dreveni Hlaren is a Dunmer Sorceress who possesses the Staff of Magnus. Ajira, a member of the Mages Guild, will send the Nerevarine to take the staff from her during the quest "Recover the Staff of Magnus."

The Lenco BearCat (Ballistic Engineered Armored Response Counter Attack Truck), sometimes referred to as an Armored Rescue Vehicle, is an armored personnel carrier designed for military and law enforcement use. Based on the Ford F-550 Super Duty Chassis, it was designed by Lenco Industries in 2001. The bodywork is fitted with half an inch thick steel with .50 caliber-rated ballistic glass capable of withstanding multiple hits, blast-resistant floors, specially designed gunports, roof hatches equipped with a mounted turret, and agency-specific equipment and/or modifications such as lights/sirens/battering ram/winches/thermal cameras and spot lights. They are primarily used to transport personnel such as SWAT units of Special Response Teams to and from hostile situations as well as to assist with the recovery and protection of civilians during terrorist threats, hostage incidents or encounters with armed offenders.
Dro'Zaymar is a Khajiit assassin who resides in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton. He possesses the unqiue Shoes of Sanguine Leaping.
Dremora Churl is a creature in . Churls are the lowest rank of Dremora. Like all Dremora, they wield both weapons and magic. Dremora churl mages may summon lesser Daedra to assist them in battle.

Dro-m'Athra are dark and powerful Khajiit spirits. One was summoned at the Sathram Plantation to wreak havoc while the Khajiit slaves escaped, but was destroyed by the Vestige. While at the plantation, it was able to infest living bodies, which it would then kill from the inside, and a copy of that person would rip out of the backs of the deceased. Almost perfect, the only flaw was the copies could not mimic speech, which made them easier to distinguish from their original counterparts. It was repelled and later destroyed by a hollow moon totem. Later, they relocate to Jode's Light in Reaper's March after their work at the plantation is done.

An airboat is a flat-bottomed vessel propelled in a forward direction by an aircraft-type propeller and powered by either an aircraft or automotive engine. Airboats are a very popular means of transportation in many marshy and/or shallow water areas where a standard inboard or outboard engine with a submerged propeller would be impractical.
Drulshasa is a powerful Dremora serving as the boss of Knife Ear Grotto.

Dro'Zira, also spelled Dro-Zira, was a Khajiit and legendary folk-hero from the early First Era. Little is known of his life and accomplishments, and what little is known is pieced together from oral tradition and often contradictory. According to legend, when the Great Cat God of Time Alkosh called his "pride" to the Battle of Red Mountain, The Last Litter Born in the Great Darkness Lorkhaj gave his "roar" to the immortal Nordic hero Wulfharth to spite the Khajiit warriors. Rather then slaying them, Wulfharth used his voice to move the moons Masser and Secunda, turning the Khajiit into senche. While fierce and powerful they had lost all ability to reason except for Dro'Zira. The others—Rhojiit—presumably became the Sabre cats which now inhabit Skyrim. Wulfharth then mounted upon Dro-Zira and rode up the slopes of Red Mountain in an attempt to reclaim the Heart of Lorkan, where they together confronted King Dumac Dwarf-Orc in its chamber along with presumably his royal guard, Indoril Nerevar, Alandro Sul, Kagrenac, Voryn Dagoth, and Vivec. When Dumac raised his sword to Wulfharth's throat, preventing him from speaking, it was Dro'Zira who saved the Ash King by pouncing upon the Dwemer lord. Sometime after these events, Dro'Zira was confined to the realm of Sheggorath from which he was rescued from by Wulfharth in turn. There exists some degree of bitterness amongst Khajiit against the Nord bards who do not recount this version of events. The prophecies of a "Dro'Jizad" are co
The Dremora Warlock is a type of Dremora in which uses magic. They can be found in the Abyss and during jobs. They are aggressive and will attack the Fugitive on sight.

The Airbus A300 is a short to medium-range wide-body twin-engine jet airliner that was developed and manufactured by Airbus in 1972 as the world's first twin-engined widebody. Production of the A300 ceased in July 2007, along with its smaller A310 derivative.
Durzol gro-Dumulg is an Orsimer Healer, and worshipper of Malacath residing in Shashpilamat.
Dwarven Spectre is a type of creature in . They are undead spirits of the Dwemer, and are found in various Dwemer ruins throughout Morrowind.
Dynus Aralas is a Dunmer werewolf boss encountered in the Blessed Crucible.

The Pierce-Arrow Anti-Aircraft Armoured Lorry was a mobile artillery vehicle produced by Wolseley Motors Ltd. of Great Britain. A Vickers Naval 2-pounder Mk II "Pom Pom" automatic gun was mated to a 5-ton truck provided by Pierce-Arrow Motor Car Company of America, and enhanced with up to 7.5mm of armor. A Maxim gun could be fitted at various points along the body, including the co-driver's armored shutter. Forty-eight of these vehicles were produced in 1914 for the Royal Marine Artillery. In Battlefield 1, the overall appearance of the Artillery Truck was inspired by it.

Edgard the Innkeeper was the Breton owner of the inn in Westtry when the village was still inhabited. Now, he is a ghost who has been forcefully risen from the dead by the Bloodthorn Cult to serve them.
Edjar is a Nord werewolf residing northeast of Dusktown in Blackreach.
Einarth is an Elder Nord and one of the five Greybeards the Dragonborn meets at High Hrothgar, near the Throat of the World.

The was a semi-automatic revolver-style handgun designed by and produced by the from 1901 to 1924. The weapon, recognisable by the zig-zag grooves on the cylinder, was chambered in both the British standard .455 Webley cartridge (with a 6-shot capacity) as well as .38 ACP (with an 8-shot capacity). It used the muzzle energy of firing a bullet to both cock the hammer and rotate the cylinder, unlike regular revolvers where this is either done manually or via pulling the trigger, which can disrupt shooting and reduce accuracy. Although this flaw was eliminated in the Fosbery system, the revolver—intended originally for use by cavalry—was officially rejected due to its weight, unwieldy length, expense to produce, and complexity. Some privately purchased examples saw service in the and subsequent World War I, but was found to be generally unsuitable for battle conditions due to frequent jamming and unusual two-handed recocking technique. Around 5,000 of these weapons were produced in total.

Efreghar is a Bosmer in residing in the Daggerfall Outlaws Refuge. She formerly cast magic for kings and nobles before having a "bad day" and burning a Breton noblewoman's eyebrows off. She suffers from severe burns on her face and body and is constantly drunk.
Elanwe is an Ayleid ghost found deep within the ruins of Belarata.
Elgenie is a Breton healer aiding the Evermore guard deal with the Dark Witnesses currently occupying Northglen, Bangkorai.

The Albatros D.III was a biplane fighter aircraft used by the Imperial German Army Air Service (Luftstreitkräfte) and the Austro-Hungarian Air Service (Luftfahrtruppen) during World War I. The D.III was flown by many top German aces, including Wilhelm Frankl, Erich Löwenhardt, Manfred von Richthofen, Karl Emil Schäfer, Ernst Udet, and Kurt Wolff. It was the preeminent fighter during the period of German aerial dominance known as "Bloody April" 1917.

Ehtayah was a Khajiit moon priestess residing at the Do'Krin Monastery. She was slain by Stonefire cultist when they stormed the place. In death, she seeks aid in sending out a prayer to her brother's, Indal, well-being as he fights on behalf of the Aldmeri Dominion on the frontlines in Cyrodiil.

Elomion was an eccentric Arch-Mage of what was most likely the College of Winterhold sometime during the First Era. He was heavily against the practice of soul-trapping, his reasoning being stated in a well-known quote of his, "Would you like to spend your afterlife powering my levitation staff?". Elomion claimed to have never once in his life cast a soul-trap spell.
Emory is the ghost of a powerful Breton bandit lord found in Windridge Cave.
Anti-Tank Mines is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked upon obtaining 10 kills with Anti-Tank Mines.

Emperor Tarish-Zi was a ruthless self-proclaimed emperor and the leader of the Anka-Ra, one of the most feared warrior bands within the Ra Gada. He was the one who razed the abandoned Nedic city of Reinhold's Retreat to the ground after he failed to find the hidden treasure found within. He and the Anka-Ra eventually settled in the region of Craglorn where they died. Even in death, his men were bound to him by an oath of eternal loyalty. This loyalty was exploited in the present when constellations fell from the skies above Craglorn and took on mortal forms known as the Celestials. Under The Celestial Serpent's control, The Warrior used divine powers to invoke great warriors of the past, and thus Tarish-Zi and the Anka-Ra were summoned forward in time. Unbeknownst to The Serpent, The Warrior also summoned Titus Valerius, a powerful Nedic warrior who would act as his champion against Tarish-Zi and his army.

Enilroth is a Bosmer who works as the apprentice of Varel Morvayn of Morvayn's Peacemakers. He remains an essential character (meaning that he is unkillable) until the Dark Brotherhood quest "Following a Lead" has been completed.

Ettiene is an Imperial Glenmoril Wyrd who can be found in the Gloomy Cave in Solstheim. Ettiene and her two sisters Isobel and Fallaise have traveled from High Rock to Skyrim to Solstheim to help those with the lycanthropy disease. When the Nerevarine first meets Ettiene at the Altar of Thrond, she is in the form of a raven and offers a note indicating where to search for a cure.
Aircraft Support is a Codex Entry featured in Battlefield 1. It is unlocked by collecting all Field Manuals in the chapter Breakdown of the singleplayer mission Through Mud and Blood.
Erns Maren is a Dunmer battlemage residing in the shrine at Ashalmawia east of Ald Velothi in the West Gash on Vvardenfell. He is hostile and will attack the Nerevarine on sight.
Estoril is an Altmer battlemage and member of the Thieves Guild who is located at the Rat in the Pot.
Exulus is a wispmother in . She has made her lair within Hrota Cave in Gold Coast. Exulus killed four warriors of Arkay: Etira Gravius, Janius Cinna, Placidia Nerva, and Salanus Rian.

The Assault Package is featured in Battlefield 1 as the default Vehicle Package for the A7V. It features six seats, one for the driver and five gunners. It provides the driver access to a 57mm Cannon with HE and case ammunition. The driver also has access to the Emergency Repair and Smokescreen specializations. As a result, this package is ideal for many different types of engagements. The second-seat rear gunner operates Twin HMGs. This package also allows up to four other gunners, each armed with an HMG, to occupy the vehicle.

Farkas is a lycanthropic Nord in who is a member of The Circle, one of the most formidable and experienced warriors in the Companions. Like the rest of the Companions, he lives in Jorrvaskr in the Wind District of Whiterun. He is a Master-level trainer in Heavy Armor and serves as the Dragonborn's shield-brother in several of the Companions' quests. He is also one of the Companions who can assign radiant quests to the Dragonborn. Upon completion of the Companions' main plotline, Farkas can be recruited as a follower and becomes a potential marriage candidate. He can be recruited into the Blades if the Dragonborn talks to Delphine while having him as a follower.
Faralenu Henim is a Dunmer healer residing in the Vivec, St. Delyn Canton.

Falmer Shaman are a type of Falmer found in at higher levels. They wear a full set of Falmer Armor and carry a Shaman's Key. This key can be used to open chests found inside Falmer huts. Like other Falmer, they may specialise in frost or shock, and often cast bound sword for use in melee combat. Although they are blind, they have very sensitive hearing like other Falmer. Falmer Shamans tend to cast wards and healing spells, along with the use of their staves.

Ammunition refers to the materials needed to fire a weapon. The Battlefield series, being a first-person shooter series with a real-life setting, has mechanics for ammunition and reloading that mirror real life behaviors. Some Battlefield games include the ability to change a weapon's caliber or bullet type, either directly or through magazine attachments.

Lady Farena Andrano is a Chimer ghost who is the ancestor of Canon Llevule. Her spirit is summoned in Andrano Ancestral Tomb under the orders of Lord Vivec, as he needs her assistance in finding out what is causing unrest in Vvardenfell.

False Wraith is a shape-shifter in the form of a Wraith in . He will give The Apprentice the Armor of the Savior's Hide if they no longer have the six pieces when they reach the Chimera of Desolation.

Felms, also known as Saint Felms the Bold, is a saint and the Patron of Butchers and Fishmongers. As a warlord he defeated the Nord invaders and drove them from Morrowind. He could neither read nor write, receiving guidance from the Tribunal gods. The Cleaver of St. Felms, a one handed axe, was originally used by Felms. During the events of , shrines dedicated to him can be found across Vvardenfell, inside Temples, such as the High Fane in Vivec City, the Ghostgate Temple in the Ashlands, or the Holamayan Monastery in the Azura's Coast region.

Albert's Accelerator is a sniper rifle featured in Battlefield Heroes. Available for the Commando kit of the Royal Army it was introduced in the Scientists bundle on February 14, 2012. Its counterpart is Moritz's Magnetic Hurler for the National Army and is statistically and functionally identical.

Felen Maryon is a Dunmer spellsword in who lives in Tel Branora, in Morrowind. He is a member of House Telvanni. Felen sells unique spells that no other spell merchant in Vvardenfell will sell. Those spells are: Command Creature, Summon Winged Twilight and Summon Golden Saint.
Fatestealer is a Winged Twilight summoned by Neposh in order to deal with Dunmer poachers trying to enslave the Argonian miners of Emberflint Mine.

The Flame Spider is a creature in . They are bright orange and red in coloration and similar in size to the average Frostbite Spider found in the mainland's caves and mountainous regions. They also are fond of caves and tend to congregate near geothermal vents and pools of lava.
The is a general purpose machine gun designed by . It can utilize both and cartridges, and is designed to be lighter than other LMGs such as the Minimi.

First Mate Wavecutter is a powerful Argonian warrior acting as first mate under Captain Blackheart. She has a chance to drop First Mate's Mark, a unique ring in the Bone Pirate's Tatters set. She periodically lobs projectiles at the party with no warning, dealing heavy damage even on normal difficulty. Healing abilities like Grand Healing and Blessing of Protection are recommended here.
Forlorn Farela is a non-hostile wraith residing in the Outlaws Refuge underneath the city of Riften. She is used to scare away the city guard by the Skull-Brethren who reside in the refuge.

Frathen Drothan is a rogue Dunmer Battlemage and Telvanni wizard who leads the Drothmeri Army and searches Varsa Baalim for Mehrunes' Razor. He wears the unique Bladeturn Hood, which protects its wearer from damage.

The armored reconnaissance vehicle combines the armored warfare capabilites with intelligence gathering. An armored reconnaissance vehicle differs from an APC/IFV in that it lacks troop transport capabilities. While being highly mobile, the armor ranges from protection against small arms fire to protection against heavy machine guns. The armament usually consists of a gun, sufficient to attack infantry and light vehicles, but unsuitable to engage main battle tanks, therefore some modern armored reconnaissance vehicles are equipped with ATMG launchers. The most armored reconnaissance vehicles drive on wheels.
Frederique Lynielle is a deceased Breton priestess of Arkay, and, at the time of the Planemeld, is a ghost.
Frelene Acques is an Breton healer who resides in the Hlaalu Prison Cells located within Vivec City of Morrowind. She is held there for questioning.
Foulwing is a harpy found at the Shrieking Scar in Glenumbra. The Vestige must defeat her in the quest "The Dagger's Edge."

The Anti-Tank kit is one of usable kits in the games Battlefield 1942 and Battlefield 2. Its main role is to destroy armored vehicles such as tanks from long range. The kit in later games is succeeded by the Demolition kit in Battlefield: Bad Company, the Engineer class in Battlefield: Bad Company 2, Battlefield 3, Battlefield 4, Battlefield 2042 and Battlefield 6, and the Assault in Battlefield 1 and Battlefield V.
Frost Mage is a class of enemy character in . There are several different Frost Mages in Online, belonging to different factions and in different regions.

Frost Daedra in are tough Daedra described as gullible and mean. They use several frost-based spells, and can be quite challenging to defeat for low-level characters. They are encountered during Level 4, Level 5 and Level 6.
Frosted Dwarven Spider is a creature in that is a part of the Forgotten Seasons Creation Club content.

An is a rifle capable of automatic fire with an cartridge from a detachable box magazine. Its cartridge falls in between the low power ammunition used in Pistols, Submachine Guns, and high power rifle ammunition used in Battle Rifles and many Sniper Rifles, allowing for more controllable recoil while still maintaining an effective range of several hundred meters. Assault rifles are meant to be lightweight and though they are weapons with large magazines, they do not have the thermal mass, cooling ability, or ammunition capacity to sustain a high volume of fire like a machine gun. They have been featured in almost every installment in the Battlefield series.
Gan Luseph is the Breton Court Wizard and healer at Castle Bruma.

Gandela Indoran is a Dunmer healer residing in Milk, a cave in the West Gash region of Morrowind. She is one of Arethan Mandas' guards. Like all other of his guards, she will be hostile to the Nerevarine until he is cured during the events of "The Mad Lord of Milk."

Gargoyle Brutes are a strong subtype of gargoyles. Gargoyle Brutes can appear to be just statues, allowing the Dragonborn to progress until surrounded before attacking. This is a deadly tactic they use to catch unsuspecting victims off-guard. They can be found inside Volkihar Ruins.

Airburst munitions are weapons designed to detonate in the air, instead of on contact with the ground or target, or a delayed armor piercing explosion. Such a weapon is more effective against targets in the open than a contact-fuzed weapon, as more fragmentation can be placed on targets, not the ground. Airburst may refer to: *PK-74 AR-Rocket - A gadget in Battlefield 2142. *25mm Airburst Grenade - A weapon/gadget type in Battlefield Play4Free and Battlefield 4. *Air-Burst Missile - A weapon type for mobile artillery in Battlefield 3. *"I'm Dynamite" - An assignment unlocking airburst mode for the UCAV in Battlefield 4. *Mortars - Feature airburst as an ammunition type in Battlefield 1. *Airburst Smoke Shells - A vehicle specialization featured in Battlefield V.

Garzonk gro-Mulakh is a hostile Orsimer healer who resides within the daedric shrine of Ibishammus. He can be found protecting a shrine dedicated to Malacath in the Underworks of the Vivec, Foreign Quarter.

Galereth, more commonly known as the Wild Witch, is a Bosmer woman found near Shademist Moors. In children's tales, it is said she can brew a cure for just about anything. Many believe she is merely a myth. The Wild Witch appears when someone needs it most.
Galondorn is an Altmer healer of the Dominion found at the Western Elsweyr Gate.

An air transport refers to any air vehicle whose primary purpose is to shuttle troops around the battlefield. In general, air transports are sturdier than other air vehicles, but do not carry heavy armament. Along with the pilot, air transports typically have two stations for door gunners, and additional seats for infantry who can make use of their personal equipment. In many games, Engineers in the rear can repair the transport mid-flight, eliminating the need for the pilot to return to base. Though the air transport itself is well-protected, its occupants often are not. Even the pilot may be vulnerable to attack, either from grenades tossed into the cockpit from behind, or by snipers wielding anti-materiel rifles. Examples include:
Gasteau Chamrond is a Breton ghost found in the Vaults of Madness.

Gaston Ashham is a powerful Breton Vampire who used to live in Wayrest, before moving with his sister, Raelynne, to Cyrodiil. While his sister settled in the Underpall Cave, Gaston went to the Ayleid Ruin of Lipsand Tarn with Marbita, an associate of his, to find a vampire coven. Leobert Charien attempted to track and kill him, but was unsuccessful. He may be found in the far back of the ruin, top-left of the map, overlooking an altar with a beam of light shining on it.
Ganakton the Tempest is a wamasu that appears in . Appearing in Arx Corinium, Ganakton was named by Imperial war wizard Belisaro after a "hated aunt, rumored to have Orcish blood."

A Ground Attack Aircraft is a fixed-wing aircraft outfitted for strikes against land-based targets such as main battle tanks, support vehicles such as tankers and troop carriers, and buildings. They typically carry armaments such as air-to-ground missiles, bombs, and high caliber cannons, but can also mount limited stores of air-to-air weapons for self-defense. These are typically 1–2 seater aircraft with performance comparable but often inferior to fighter aircraft, while carrying lighter payloads and less crew than purpose-built bomber aircraft.
Gangatru the Apostate is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She mainly uses ranged and AoE attacks.

Galgalah is a Dunmer ancient and powerful spirit known as a body shifter. He menaces the Northern coast of Vvardenfell east along the coastal path from Urshilaku, the Ashlander camp found north-east of Gnisis. The spirit entices travelers to his lair and possesses their bodies. The tower of Valenvaryon acts as a prison for captured souls, his true lair lies to the south beneath a bridge spanning a Lava river.

Germia is an Imperial vampire and a member of the Clan Berne in Galom Daeus. If the quest "The Blood of the Quarra" has been completed, she will have a few stealth-oriented items for sale, although she will be hostile to anyone who's not a member of the clan.

Anvil may refer to: *Anvil 3-2 - A call sign of an M1A2 Abrams tank in Battlefield 3. *Anvil 3-3 - A call sign of an M1A2 Abrams tank in Battlefield 3. *Anvil 2 - A call sign of an M1A2 Abrams tank in Battlefield 4. *Devil's Anvil - An Operations featured in Battlefield 1.
General Virane is a ghost boss in that resides inside Toadstool Hollow. Defeating General Virane is part of the Toadstool Hollow Explorer achievement.
Giant Bats are creatures found in High Rock. They have low health and attack, but high speed. Their attacks have 5% chance per hit of transmitting a disease.
Ghob gra-Gholob is a hostile Orsimer Healer and Daedra-worshipper found at Assurdirapal.
This is an index of all arrows that are or were meant to be available to the Phantom bow.
Ghost of Perennia Draconis is an undead creature in . The ghost can only be found once Perennia Draconis' tombstone at Applewatch has been activated after the completion of the quest "Next of Kin."
Ghyslain is a powerful Wraith found in the Crow's Wood. He is summoned by killing the other wraiths.
Glenhwyfaunva was a witch-serpent from Elven Wood. She was slain by Oreyn Bearclaw, a legendary Bosmer hero from Valenwood.

Battlefield 2: Armored Fury is the second booster pack released for Battlefield 2, introducing three new maps, as well as three new vehicle classes. The pack features the USMC defending U.S. soil from invasions from the PLA and MEC. With the 1.5 Patch, the Armored Fury and Euro Force Booster Packs were added to the base game at no extra charge.

The Glenmoril Wyrd (also known as the Witches of Glenmoril) are witches from the Glenmoril Witches Coven, and have the knowledge of how to cure lycanthropy. Some witches of Glenmoril can turn themselves into animal forms, such as ravens. They are seen as rivals of the Cyrodiil Vampyrum Order. The Glenmoril Wyrd Coven are known to be Hircine worshippers. Unlike other covens the Glenmoril are everywhere, mostly in the cities, while other witches live in seclusion. The witches of the coven know how to cure lycanthropy through two ways. One method is a ritual called the 'Rite of the Wolf Giver', in which an innocent person is required to be slaughtered by the afflicted lycanthrope. The other is the Scroll of the Wolf Ender, which the witches can make. However, even though the witches of Glenmoril know how to make the scroll, they still choose to do the ritual. Melisande is rumored to be one of the last witches of Glenmoril. She knows how to cure vampirism, and she offers this to the Hero of Kvatch in . It is unknown if the entire Coven also shares this secret.
Goblin Bruiser is a high ranked goblin of Mournhold found from level 20th in .
Godyna Varam is a Dunmer ghost found in the ruins of Othrenis.

The BGM-71 TOW is an American anti-tank guided missile. "TOW" stands for "Tube-launched, Optically-tracked, Wire-guided". The TOW was first produced in 1970 and is the most widely used Anti-Tank guided missile in the world.
Golden Jack is a Darkwater Rabbit found north of Fort Amol. He moves at a much higher speed than his unnamed counterparts, making him much more difficult to kill during the quest "Best of the Best."
Grantham Blakeley, better known as The Forlorn Watchman, is the ghost of a dead sailor who wanders the shores of Niben Bay.

Gray Host Bloodknights are generic bloodknights that can be encountered in Western Skyrim and the Reach. They can be found at the Greymoor Keep. The taller and stronger version of bloodknights appears when enough lost souls are sacrificed at the witch pikes during harrowstorms.

The BMD-3 "Bakhcha" is an Infantry Fighting Vehicle originating from the Soviet Union, it is fully amphibious and air-droppable with crew inside. It has one 30mm cannon and two 7.62x54mm machine guns and an additional 30mm grenade launcher. It is intended to be a fire-support platform for use by airborne and air assault units. The BMD-3 Bakhcha AA is a fictional variant armed with a ZU-23-2 anti-aircraft gun and a grenade launcher; it is used in the Battlefield: Bad Company series. __TOC__
Gristle is an unattackable dog found near its master, Sigva, in Kvatch, near Flora's House.
Grundwulf is a monster set in . It is based on Grundwulf from Moongrave Fane.
Guring the Swiftblade is a powerful Nord found with her Bear, Beralagr, at her camp.

The (Russian: Боевая Mашина Полевой реактивной системы М-21 Boevaya mashina Polevoĭ ryeaktivnoĭ sistemy M-21; English: Combat Vehicle rocket system, Field M-21) was a Soviet multiple rocket launcher system designed in 1964. Developed from the same principle as the Katyusha, the BM-21 was used as a mobile, long range artillery weapon, as it could fire large, heavy and powerful 122mm rockets in rapid succession (120 per minute) at a range of up to 20 kilometers (12.4 miles). __TOC__

Hafnar Ice-Fist was a Nord sorcerer and a member of Atmah's expedition to Labyrinthian, who was killed there with most of the others. His ghost can still be found there in various places where strong psychic impressions of past conversations and events were left behind.

Haekwon is a Redguard worshipper of the Daedric Prince Boethiah, and can be found at the Prince's shrine. Haekwon spends all of his time worshipping Boethiah, never taking a break to eat or sleep. He believes any outsiders who discover the shrine are foolish if they wish to approach the shrine, as any who are found unworthy risk a brutal death. He cannot be killed without finishing "Boethiah's Quest."

Haknir Death-Brand, also known as the King of Ghosts, was a legendary Pirate king who ruled over the Sea of Ghosts. He is an enemy found in the Nordic ruin of Gyldenhul Barrow at the conclusion of the quest "Deathbrand."

The BMP-3 (Russian: Боевая Машина Пехоты, Boyevaya Mashina Pekhoty; English: Infantry Combat Vehicle) is an amphibious infantry fighting vehicle designed by Kurganmashzavod of the Soviet Union. It is successor to the BMP-1 and BMP-2 and still is in service with the Russian Federation. __TOC__
Hands-That-Heal is an Argonian healer of the Bright-Throat Tribe who can be found in the Bright-Throat Village. Long ago, his village including the Hist tree were burnt down by Imperial raiders.
Harpy is a creature in . They can only be damaged with Dwarven weapons or better.

Lord Harkon is a Nord vampire Lord, the head of the Volkihar Clan in , and the primary antagonist, regardless of the side taken during Bloodline. A powerful Vampire Lord, Harkon rules his brood with an iron fist. He will stop at nothing to achieve his goals, even if it means the estrangement of his own family. Harkon is one of the few individuals in Tamriel capable of granting pure-blood vampirism.

The BTR-4 Romanov (Russian: БТР-4 Романов) is an Armored Personel Carrier used by the Pan-Asian Coalition in the 22nd Century. It is one of the APCs featured in Battlefield 2142. The driver operates a fast-firing LMG turret with an EMP grenade launcher that can immobilize other vehicles. The gunner remotely operates a mortar system that fires three shells with an effective range of 250 meters. All passengers can use slower-firing LMG turrets. Passengers also have access to assault pod launchers that can be used for quick escape, for boarding Titans or other high points, and as a makeshift anti-aircraft weapon. When near a Titan (or the loading platforms in Port Bavaria), the pod launch system pressurizes to full strength, with an indicator available to the driver. Otherwise, the pods only permit limited ascent. The Romanov has an overall armor level comparable to a main battle tank, but does not take additional damage to any side of the vehicle. As with many armored ground vehicles in the Battlefield series, anti-vehicle weapons that impact face-on inflict more damage than glancing hits.

Hasedoki was an ancient wizard who was always in search of a wizard greater than himself. He never met any who could meet up to his challenge and felt very lonely and isolated. He eventually bonded his life-force into his staff, Staff of Hasedoki, which still holds his soul. His staff can be found in .
Helene Danise is a Breton found in Kerbol's Hollow. She was attacked and bitten by a werewolf recently and is found in a cage, undergoing the transformation.
Hevnoraak (Dragon Language: Hevnoraak, "") is one of the named dragon priests. He is the primary antagonist of the quest "Evil in Waiting."

The BTR-20 Yastreb (Russian: БТР-20 Ястреб, or "Hawk") is a VTOL (Vertical Take Off and Landing) aircraft used by the Pan-Asian Coalition in the 22nd Century. It is encountered in Battlefield 2142, being a usable aircraft. The BTR-20 is a durable yet slow transport vehicle. It features a "fool proof" flight system that allows the vehicle to level its flight path and slowly travel forward if the pilot lets go of the controls. It seats seven people, but only the pilot is fully protected; both the passengers controlling the cannons and the ones sitting on the sides are exposed to small arms fire and, more importantly, splash damage.

High King Durac is a former Nedic monarch encountered within the Skyreach Catacombs. He remained alive through the years due to a vampiric curse that was cast on him long ago. He was a powerful king who married his daughter Princess Saradin to Kestic, spurning his advisor and her friend Virmaril. In return, Virmaril slaughtered Durac and his council, and enslaved them with necromantic powers. He is fought as a boss in the initial part of the catacombs in the north. He raises the other kings again as Draugr.
High Kinlord Rilis X is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis.

High Kinlord Rilis XII is an Altmer ghost of the Rilis family found in the catacombs beneath Castle Rilis, and the father of the current 13th Rilis. With his mistress Lady Elanwe, he fathered an illegitimate son named Sorondil.

The BK-1990, or known by its designation as the Type 92 in the People's Liberation Army, is an amphibious Chinese self-propelled assault gun. It is the combination of an extended and heavily modified WZ551 chassis and a BK-1970 122mm cannon and is manufactured by Norinco. Being classified as a self-propelled artillery gun, the BK-1990 acts much more akin to a modern-day tank destroyer than an artillery piece, due to its lower-caliber main gun. The vehicle is also armed with a secondary Type 85 HMG in a ring mount above the turret, allowing a gunner to provide infantry support in battle.

Hermorah is the Khajiiti interpretation of the Daedric Prince Hermaeus Mora. He was among the second litter of Ahnurr and Fadomai. Fadomai gave him the tides, "for who can say whether the moons predict the tides or the tides predict the moons?" Hermorah supposedly records everything he perceives and stores it in a great library under the sea. Azurah is a frequent visitor to this library, and he shares all of his secrets with her. For example, he shared with her the knowledge of how to maintain the moons and their motions after Khenarthi proved unable to do so. Khajiit seeking to enter his library must often face Sheggorath as an obstacle. Hermorah should not be called unless one wishes to be tested along the path, as it is best to leave him at his duty.
Hildegard is a Nord werewolf and assassin residing in the Dark Brotherhood Sanctuary.
The Highland Pyromancer is a generic Imperial enemy pyromancer in . They are members of the Colovian Highlands and are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a Disguise.

The Ural-375 is a 4½ ton general purpose 6x6 truck that is used by the Soviet Union. Built at the Ural Automotive plant, it became the standard transport truck of the Red Army in 1979 and was used to great success as a mounting platform for the BM-21 rocket launcher later on. The Ural-375D variant was the most produced variant. It has a payload capacity of 4,500kg (9,920lbs) and can tow a trailer that brings its maximum capacity up to 10,000kg (22,050lbs). The truck also has a range of 750km (465 miles) on a single tank of gas. It was used by many Eastern Bloc countries, as well as being sold to other communist states like China and North Vietnam. __TOC__

Hira was the last emperor of Yokuda. He persecuted the Ansei, and sent his brigand army of Orcs and war castoffs to wipe them out. He sent one hundred of his personal guards to arrest the famous Divad Hunding. His guards managed to capture him until one of them killed his aging mother, which awoke the spirit of the Way in Divad and led to his escape and subsequent resistance against Hira. Divad managed to convince his father Frandar to go to war against Hira in the War of the Singers. The Ansei were greatly outnumbered initially, and led Hira's troops from their original invasion point of High Desert to the foot of Mount Hattu. Frandar planned to fight seven battles here, with the Singers growing in power with the Shehai until triumphed over Hira's forces. Little is known of Hira's life or death, save that he had a consort named Elisa.

Hoag Merkiller was a Nord High King of Skyrim in the First Era. He is considered to be one of the greatest war chiefs of his time and instrumental in the formation of the First Empire of the Nords. Hoag was also known to be a powerful Tongue, as it was shown in his battles against Morrowind's armies during the Skyrim Conquests. During this time he purportedly destroyed seventeen Chimeri villages and two Dwemer strongholds, which led the Dunmer to vilify him as "Hoaga, the Mouth of Mud," a vicious demon with necromantic powers. He attended the coronation of Emperor Gorieus on the 23rd of Sun's Dawn in 1E 461, along with his father and High King, Kjoric the White. Kjoric later rebelled against the Emperor, but was killed at the Battle of Sungard in 1E 477 or 1E 478. After this, the Moot named Hoag as the new High King. His reign was short-lived however, as he was killed at the Battle of Glenumbria Moors 1E 480 or some time between 1E 461 and 1E 477. He was succeeded by Wulfharth.
Hollow Heart is a wraith miniboss found in Blackheart Haven in .
The Barrakuda Barrel is a weapon attachment featured in Battlefield Play4Free.
Hleran Magister is a Dunmer ghost and Hleran family ancestor residing in Hleran Ancestral Tomb.

Hulking Draugr is a creature in . The Hulking Draugr's most notable difference from other draugr is the skin color, which is dark brown instead of pale gray. The armor is also different, with larger, more distinct shoulder pads and a rag-like lower half. The armor of the Hulking Draugr appears to be fashioned out of leather and furs stitched together, with a metal waist piece and shoulder pauldron. They also appear to be wearing a necklace made of human hands.

Hrothmund the Red is the Nordic founder of the Thirsk Mead Hall along with other Skaal Village members who left to found the Hall. He beheaded Drengr Bronze-Helm and held his head as a trophy in the middle of the hall. This testament of his strength led him to become the first Chieftain of the Mead Hall. This tradition of electing a chieftain by duel, is set as the standard for the Mead Hall. He died fighting Ondjage, the Fell Wolf. His rule lasted for 21 years. He lived in the third century of the Third Era, contrary to the claims of some saying he lived in the Second Era. His place of burial along with his axe, Hrothmund's Axe, is in Hrothmund's Barrow.

The Battlefield 3: Armored Kill Gameplay Trailer is the first gameplay trailer of Battlefield 3: Armored Kill that was released to the public. "Epic Tank" from the Battlefield 3 Premium Edition soundtrack is played in the background.
Hubert is a Breton ghost found in Bearclaw Mine. He is a cousin of Mashana.
Idgrod Ravencrone is an Elder Nord Jarl of Hjaalmarch, headquartered in Morthal. She sides with the Empire in the Civil War of Skyrim. She purports to be a seer of psychic visions and dreams.

Iceheart is a Frost Atronach found in Direfrost Keep in . It is the penultimate boss, located just southwest of the ladder leading to the final boss and the summit. It can be skipped, but is required for the pledge and dungeon achievements. It may drop the Shard of Iceheart (Ice Furnace axe).
The Battlefield 3: Armored Kill Launch Trailer was released to celebrate the release of the vehicle-themed expansion pack Battlefield 3: Armored Kill.
Indelor is a Bosmer Healer residing in Eagle's Strand, Khenarthi's Roost.
Incarnate Aduri is a Dunmer ghost and failed incarnate of Indoril Nerevar, haunting the Cavern of the Incarnate on Vvardenfell.
Incarnate Danaat is a Dunmer ghost and failed incarnate of Indoril Nerevar, haunting the Cavern of the Incarnate on Vvardenfell.

A Ballistic Shield or Tactical Shield is a hand-held shield that is capable of defending the user from handguns, shotguns and submachine guns. Less common are heavier and thicker rifle-protection shields that are mounted on wheels for ease of mobility. Ballistic shields have been used by law enforcement and military throughout the twentieth and twenty-first centuries.

Investigator Garron is a Breton necromancer and former investigator of the Lion Guard who turned on his allies while they were scouting Wayrest Sewers I. He will teleport around the room in battle. It is recommended to kill the mobs around him (ie in the corner to the left of the staircase) before engaging him.
Iver is a Nord Battlemage and a member of the Mages Guild, holding the rank of Evoker.
J'Rasha is a Khajiit healer who has a shop in the eastern Canalworks of the Vivec, Foreign Quarter.

An Armored Truck is commonly used to safely transport valuables, such as large quantities of money (especially for banks or retail companies). This benefits the bank because it gives the bank employees more time to work with the customers and provides a security net, to the owner knowing their money is in good hands. The armored car is a multifunctional vehicle designed to protect and ensure the well being of the transported contents. The armored car is completely bulletproof and can withstand extreme degrees of heat.
Iroroon is an Altmer nightblade and vampire who resides in the vampire hideout of Ashmelech.
Ismenida is a Maormer member of the Sea Vipers. She is one of the three mages taking part in the summoning of the storm that is to be used to destroy Mistral.
Iskra the Omen is a Daedric Titan boss that can be found in the Vaults of Madness in Coldharbour.

Battlefield 1 allows for the customization of weapon and vehicle appearances through the use of skins. These skins can be obtained through the completion of specific tasks within the game or by being awarded them from Battlepacks.
Jackdaw Pyromancers are enemies encountered in Haven before the completion of "Unsafe Haven." This enemy is a member of the Jackdaw Pirates.

King Joile was a historical Breton ruler of Daggerfall during the early-to-mid First Era. He led Daggerfall's forces against the First Orsinium for at least twenty-three years, and commanded a failed invasion of Hammerfell during the Battle of Bangkorai Pass in which he perished.

Jeek of the River was one of the captains of the Five Hundred Companions and a friend of the legendary Ysgramor, and it's said that he and his crew were among Ysgramor's personal favorites. According to the tales, he was a great beast of a man who stood head and shoulders above the tallest men of his crew and possessed of the strength of a bear, the heart of a saber cat and the ferocity of a troll. His weapons of choice were a war axe he inherited from his father called Relkjard, or "Foecrusher," and a silver-edged greatsword of burnished steel he'd forged himself and called Bjarskor, meaning "Fireblade," and he wore a suit of armor fashioned by the finest Atmoran craftsmen from metals of the highest quality. Jeek commanded a longboat named Jorrvaskr - whose hull is now used as the roof of the Companions' mead hall that also bears its proud name - and its crew of twenty-two warriors. He lived sometime in the late Merethic Era.
Battle Mechanic is a kit featured in Incursions gamemode of Battlefield 1 in the Vehicle Operator categories. They have access to vehicles in game.
Jine is a Redguard healer residing in Ashinabi in the smuggler den at the far end of the cave system.
Jolinne Lastblood is a Nord ghost found at the Bonestrewn Crest.
Jone is the Aldmeri god of the little moon. She is also known as Secunda and Stendarr's Sorrow. In Khajiit religion, Jone is one of the aspects of the Lunar Lattice, or ja-Kha'jay.

Customization in Battlefield 2042 allows players to modify Specialist and vehicle loadouts. Four loadouts are available to modify and switch between. Each loadout contains a slot for a primary and secondary weapon, a gadget, and a throwable. Each weapon features four attachment slots: sight, ammunition, underbarrel, and barrel. Each attachment slot can hold three attachments which can be switched between during gameplay by using the Plus System. Players may also customize the weapons of vehicles for each seat within a vehicle. Outside of gameplay, players may customize their Player Card Images, Tags, and Badges for display during gameplay. The appearance of Specialists, weapons, and vehicles may be changed with cosmetics. Specialists cosmetics are divided between Uniforms, Headgear and Takedowns. Weapons feature skins and Charms while vehicles feature camos and Decals. Cosmetics are unlocked by leveling up, completing Mastery Tiers, Weekly Missions, and special events. Cosmetics are available in four rarities: Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary.

Jovron Direnni was one of many famous members of the Direnni Bloodline. His granddaughter was Medora Direnni. He himself was "Imperial Battlemage to the court of the Dunmer Empress of Tamriel, Katariah, assisting her in creating peace in a time of turmoil." In turn, Jovron's grandfather, Pelladil Direnni, "had a similar role with the first Potentate, and encouraged the Guild Act without which we would not have all the professional organizations we have today."

Kalthar is a Nord Battlemage who resides in the Leyawiin Mages Guild. He is not happy that Dagail is still the head of the local guild hall. While most in the hall are upset, Kalthar expresses almost outright anger when the Hero speaks to him.

Kewan is a Redguard worshipper of the Daedric Prince Peryite. He is frozen in a trance that relates to the Daedric quest, but can be unfrozen in completion the quest "Peryite." He is unable to be killed without finishing the Peryite quest. Kewan wears Monk Robes, is armed with an Iron Dagger, and carries a few Septims. He knows the standard Nightblade spells and additional major Alteration and minor Destruction spells.

The (Russian: БМП-2, Боевая Машина Пехоты Boyevaya Mashina Pekhoty; English: combat machine/vehicle (of the) infantry) is a Soviet Union/Russian infantry fighting vehicle armed with a 30mm cannon and a coaxial PKT machine gun. It also has a powerful Spandrel Anti-Armor rocket launcher usually mounted as a secondary weapon. It has seen extensive service in the and is used by a number of Middle Eastern and Eastern European armies to this day. __TOC__
Karstaag is a creature found in . He has high health and is highly resistant to frost magic and the largest creature found on Solstheim.
Kayd at-Sal is a Redguard Werewolf encountered in the Blessed Crucible.
The Keeper of Knowledge is a Breton ghost found in the ruins of Dresan Keep, Glenumbra, in .

.]] A Battle Pickup is a weapon (special or not) or gadget located at a certain location within a multiplayer map, differing from the weapons normally chosen by a player depending on their kit. Battle Pickups are reminiscent of and other early FPS games that required players to search for weapons and valuable items. These weapons are often far more powerful than the player's own, giving the team that gets them first a tactical advantage. However, the mechanic of Battle Pickups is also used for secret Easter Egg weapons that are hidden on some maps for the player to find.

Karolis was a Redguard prince and the great-grandfather of Camaron, king of Sentinel in the 5th Century of the Third Era, in . Karolis was a sorcerer of no mean skill and turned himself into a lich, which resided in the dungeons beneath Samuruik in Sentinel.

The Unamed Khajiit Monk was a Khajiit monk who mastered the Whispering Fang Style. For unknown reasons, an assassination contract was put out on him with the Dark Brotherhood. Arnbjorn was assigned to kill him, who then skinned the Monk and used his skin as a loincloth.
The Kindlespit Dragon Frog is a pet dragon frog in available through the Crown Store. It was released in conjunction with the DLC.
The Battlefield: Bad Company 2: Vietnam Soundtrack consists of fourteen era songs heard through the expansion as either menu music or vehicle radio.
Kinther is a Redguard healer and the replacement for Ohtesse, a member of the Great Chapel of Arkay in Cheydinhal who dies in the quest "The Sword of the Crusader."

Kornalus Frey is an Altmer mage. He lives and works in Harmugstahl and conducts experiments on Frostbite Spiders using a special serum (as revealed in a research note), infusing them with frost, shock and fire. As evidenced by the shrine in his bedroom, Kornalus is, like many other magicians, a worshiper of Julianos.
Krosogar, Warden of Frozen Souls is a Xivkyn in . He may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. He primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.

Battle Rifle in reality]] A is a rifle capable of automatic fire with a full power rifle cartridge (like the ) from a detachable box magazine. Battle rifles fall in between Assault rifles and fully fledged Machine Guns in terms of power, usually sacrificing control and close-quarter effectiveness for stopping power and range. Because of their effectiveness at range, battle rifles are sometimes repurposed as Designated Marksman Rifles in modern militaries. Battle rifles appear many installments off the Battlefield series, but usually are not sorted into a unique category. Instead, they are often paired together with assault rifles or Light machine guns/.
The Lamia is a semi-aquatic creature that dwells in or near the water and regenerates health in darkness while immersed in water.
Lady Essenia, also known as the Blood Queen, is a Breton vampire in .
Lazonthagish is a powerful spiritual Watcher found inside the Skyreach Pinnacle.
The Messerschmitt Bf 109, often called the Me 109, was a German World War II Luftwaffe fighter aircraft designed by Willy Messerschmitt and Robert Lusser during the early to mid 1930s. __TOC__

Llaren Terano is a Dunmer sorcerer who resides in the Arena of Rotheran and worships Molag Bal. Llaren has gotten a hold of the Ice Blade of the Monarch. He took it from Adusamsi Assurnarairan who was sent by the Imperial Cult to get it. Llaren will be hostile and will attack on sight.
Lieutenant Bran is a Breton Werewolf found at The Wolf's Camp. Defeating him along with Annyce and Salazar the Wolf will clear this boss location.
Lisondor is an Altmer ghost found in the ruins of Castle Rilis.
Beam Scanning is an electronically scanning vehicle radar sensor for jets.

Lieutenant Fazumir is a Pahmar-Khajiit boss residing in the northeastern corner of Rimmen Necropolis in . He uses powerful frost attacks that can easily kill the Vestige if they hit, especially the homing ice attacks that appear on the ground. It is recommended to keep one's distance and stay mobile.
Lloden Tenim is a Dunmer Battlemage who resides in the Daedric Shrine of Maelkashishi in Morrowind.
Lord Berich Vlindrel is a gloom wraith in . It is the evil form of Sir Berich, and is encountered by the Hero during the quest "The Sword of the Crusader" in Underpall Cave.

The Battlefield 3: Thunder Run Tank Gameplay Trailer was a gameplay trailer shown by Electronic Arts at E3 2011 by Executive Producer Patrick who was controlling the player. The trailer was the second trailer showing gameplay from Battlefield 3's campaign, the first being the Fault Line Trailers.
Lord Janic was an evil lord known to have seven lich followers. Lord Janic was killed by Frandar Hunding in his ninetieth duel. After defeating Lord Janic, Frandar Hunding deemed himself invincible.

Lord Nunex Faleria is a spectral Lich found haunting Tribune's Folly. In life, he was an Imperial Lord who had partial rulership of Kvatch during the Alessian Doctrines in the First Era. He hid his Ayleid family within his holding, Fort Faleria, in order to keep them safe from the First Empire. His secret was discovered decades later, and in revenge cast a spell that obliterated the Alessian Army at his gate, along with his fort. He then buried his children on the surface and retreated to the ground, sealing the entrance behind him.

Lotus is a unique Indrik that appears in . It is involved in the quest "Untamed and Unleashed," and is one of the few passive, tamed Indriks in the Summerset Isles. Lotus belongs to Queen Ayrenn's royal menagerie. __NOTOC__

Below Radar is an aircraft specialization in Battlefield 3 and Battlefield 4. It is a permanent upgrade, meaning that it does not have to be selected at the Customization screen unlike other specializations. It is also a passive upgrade - it is not activated via pressing a button like IR Flares for example, instead it takes effect when flying at a low altitude.
Madaynu Aravel is a Dunmer bandit healer who resides in the cave of Sanabi.
Maarselok (Dragon Language: ) is a boss dragon in that resides in the Lair of Maarselok.
Maelmoth the Mysterious is a Nord ghost encountered in various locations throughout Western Skyrim during the stages of the quest "The Maelmoth Mysterium" in .

Customization in Battlefield 3 allows the customization of soldier and vehicle loadouts. Each kit contains a slot for primary and secondary weapons, two gadget slots, and a specialization slot. Soldier camouflage is also expanded from Battlefield 3. Vehicle loadouts consist of primary weapon slot, a specialization slot, and a countermeasure gadget slot. Primary weapons have three attachment slots while secondary weapons have three attachment slots. The three attachment slots for primary weapons are optics, barrel, and grip. Attachments serve to improve the performance of a weapon such as reducing weapon recoil or the addition of a flashlight. Players may also customize their dog tags which will be displayed on killcards. Premium members also have the option to customize the appearance of their soldiers and weapons with camouflage. Camouflage patterns are unlocked for Premium members as they achieve player progression and are different for each faction. __TOC__

Malacath (Daedric script: ), sometimes called Malak, Orkey, Mauloch, and the Blue God, is the Daedric Prince of lies, deception, hypocrisy, curses, patron of the spurned and the ostracized, keeper of the Sworn Oath, and the Bloody Curse.
Majni is a Nord who leads of the Frostmoon Pack, a small faction of werewolves.

Magnar Child-Eater, or Magnar Bearstorm, is a werewolf and leader of the Magnar Pack that is located in the Argent Mine in Wrothgar. It is said that he was never seen in human form, and that when he first came to Wrothgar, scores of children were missing.

Customization in Battlefield 4 allows the customization of soldier and vehicle loadouts. Each kit contains a slot for primary and secondary weapons, two gadget slots, and one slot each for grenades, melee weapons, field upgrades, and camouflage. Soldier camouflage is also expanded from Battlefield 3. Players can now create Emblems that can be displayed on uniforms, weapons, vehicles, and killcards. Vehicle loadouts feature slots for primary and secondary weapons, countermeasures, field upgrades, and vehicle paint. Primary weapons have five attachment slots while secondary weapons have three attachment slots. The five attachment slots for primary weapons are optics, accessories, barrel, underbarrel, and weapon paint. Attachments serve to improve the performance of a weapon such as reducing weapon recoil or the addition of a flashlight. By unlocking additional options through progression or Battlepacks, players may also customize dog tags and create Emblems that can be displayed on soldier uniforms, weapons, vehicles and killcards. Soldiers, weapons, and vehicles now feature a much wider variety of camouflage patterns.
Mamaea is the Dunmer Healer in the Ashlanders Ahemmusa Camp. She can be found in her yurt, healing her fellow Ashlanders and the occasional hurt visitor.

Malevolent Spirit is a ghost created by Sanessalmo as Merion's feminine ideal in order to entrance him in the Tower of the Tale. While the spirit will antagonize the Vestige, she cannot actually be interacted with.
Marie Palielle is the chapel healer at Skingrad's Great Chapel of Julianos. She is an Apprentice Restoration Trainer, but does not begin training until after 4:00 PM.

Battlefield Hardline features customization options in a similar manner to Battlefield 4, allowing the customization of soldier and vehicle loadouts. Four different loadouts are able to be saved for each kit. Kits contain a slot for primary and secondary weapons, two gadget slots, and one slot each for grenades, melee weapons, reputation, and agent outfits. Players may also create Emblems that can be displayed on uniforms, weapons, vehicles, killcards, and may also be spray painted on any surface. Vehicle loadouts feature slots for primary weapons, countermeasures, optics, specializations, and vehicle paints. Gunner seats may also be customized with optics and specializations. Primary weapons have four attachment slots while secondary weapons have three attachment slots. The five attachment slots for primary weapons are optics, accessories, muzzles, and grips, and weapon paint. Attachments serve to improve the performance of a weapon such as reducing weapon recoil or the addition of a flashlight. The appearance of agents, weapons, and vehicles may also be customized. Customization options are obtained by purchasing with currency or may be random items in Battlepacks. Vouchers may also be used to obtain items free of charge. Vouchers may only be used once for a specific Agent outfit or vehicle paint. The Gun Bench also allows players to further customize all unlocked weapon paints, weapon reticles, and Agent outfits with four different color slots.

Once inside, the plane became unstable, trapping them inside.

The Becker Type M2 20mm Cannon was an automatic cannon produced by Becker Steelworks of Germany. It was used during World War I by a variety of aircraft such as the Gotha G.IV. It was succeeded by the Oerlikon 20mm cannon, used to this day.

Minotaurs are forest creatures that have the physical features of both man and bull, much like the one described in the Greek mythological story of Ovid's. They are nearly twice the height of a man and move with an agility deceptive of their bulky size. Minotaurs will utilize their sharp horns and incredible upper-body strength in combat, as well as wield massive warhammers. Their horns are valuable and are useful alchemy ingredients. They appear in as well as . The more powerful variant, the Minotaur Lord, only appears in Oblivion. They are often in the areas Moranda and Sancre Tor. They can also be found protecting the Unicorn at Harcane Grove specifically, but are known to wander the West Weald as a whole.

Miraak (Dragon Language: Mir–Aak, Allegiance–Guide), also known as the First Servant, and the First Dragonborn, was an ancient Dragonborn and Dragon Priest who ruled Solstheim during the Merethic Era. He betrayed the dragons and his fellow priests by allying himself to Daedric Prince Hermaeus Mora to pursue knowledge in the name. In the Fourth Era, Miraak, from his large temple, used his magical powers to overtly influence the people of Solstheim, making them unknowingly work for him around the island while they slept.
Miranya is a ghost found just outside Eagle's Strand. She appears after picking up the book Masterwork of the Inducer and is being attacked by a Watcher.

Battlefield V: Lightning Strikes is the second chapter in the Tides of War live service for Battlefield V. Centering around vehicle play, serving to introduce new limited time gamemodes to the game. The update for the chapter was released on January 15, 2019 with the chapter ongoing from January 17, 2019 to March 21, 2019. New gamemodes in the chapter were only available for a limited time, with several later being added to the game permanently due to positive feedback. More features and content for the chapter were released throughout February and March 2019.

Morwha, commonly known as the Teat God, is a Yokudan fertility goddess parallel to Mara. She is the favorite of Tall Papa's wives, and one of the central deities in the Redguard Pantheon. She is still worshipped in various areas of Hammerfell, including Stros M'kai. In all depictions of Morwha, she has four arms so that she can "grab more husbands." The Imperial god Arkay is associated with Morwha in terms of being able to heal worshippers. A conservatorium in her honor existed in Hegathe as late as 1E 2920, as Queen Rijja's sister, Corda, was an initiate in this conservatorium.
